grant-pageexchange:
{{doc-grant|pageexchange}}
Label of the grant that allows a bot password or OAuth consumer to use the pageexchange right, shown when the bot password is created.
pageexchange-logdesc: This is the log of actions related to the Page Exchange extension.
pageexchange-installed: A section header for packages that have been installed on the wiki
pageexchange-available:
A section header for packages that are available to be installed on the wiki
{{identical|Available}}
pageexchange-installpackage:
An edit summary. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of a "package" of wiki pages
pageexchange-updatepackage:
An edit summary. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of a "package" of wiki pages
pageexchange-uninstallpackage:
An edit summary. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of a "package" of wiki pages
pageexchange-installpackagelog:
A log action description. The first parameter is ignored. Parameters:
* $2 - the name of a "package" of wiki pages
* $3 - the name of the creator of this package
pageexchange-updatepackagelog:
A log action description. The first parameter is ignored. Parameters:
* $2 - the name of a "package" of wiki pages
* $3 - the name of the creator of this package
pageexchange-uninstallpackagelog:
A log action description. The first parameter is ignored. Parameters:
* $2 - the name of a "package" of wiki pages
* $3 - the name of the creator of this package
pageexchange-package-requiredextensions: A label for the list of MediaWiki extensions required for this package to work
pageexchange-package-requiredpackages: A label for the list of wiki page "packages" that must be installed for the current package to work
pageexchange-package-morerecent: An info message about a "package" of wiki pages that has been installed on this wiki
pageexchange-pagehaschanged: An info message, displayed right after the name of the page
pageexchange-latestvalue:
A message that says what the most recent value is for an attribute whose value can change at any time. Parameters:
* $1 - the most recent value
pageexchange-uninstallablepackage: The header of a warning message
pageexchange-packageidnull: An error message when URL misses a necessary parameter
pageexchange-packagenotexists: An error message when no package exists
pageexchange-packagealreadyinstalled: An info message that package is already installed
pageexchange-packagenotavailable:
An error message when an installed package is not found in any configured package file. Parameters:
* $1 - the global ID of the package
pageexchange-packagefileerror:
An API warning when a package file could not be loaded. Parameters:
* $1 - the URL of the package file
* $2 - the error message
pageexchange-packagesourceunavailable:
An error message when an installed package cannot be updated because the package file it was installed from could not be loaded. Parameters:
* $1 - the global ID of the package
* $2 - the URL of the package file
pageexchange-packageerror:
An API warning when one package in a package file could not be loaded. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the package
* $2 - the URL of the package file
* $3 - the error message
pageexchange-packageloadfailed:
An error message when the requested package is defined in a package file but could not be loaded. Parameters:
* $1 - the global ID of the package
* $2 - the error message
pageexchange-packagenotfoundincomplete:
An error message when the requested package was not found and some package files or packages could not be loaded. Parameters:
* $1 - the global ID of the package
* $2 - the number of package files and packages that could not be loaded
pageexchange-packagesourceambiguous:
An API warning when a package without a recorded source is defined in several package files. Parameters:
* $1 - the global ID of the package
* $2 - comma separated list of package file URLs
pageexchange-packagesourcechanged:
An API warning when a package is updated from a different package file than the one it was installed from. Parameters:
* $1 - the global ID of the package
* $2 - the URL of the previous package file
* $3 - the URL of the new package file
pageexchange-jobstateunknown: An API warning when the state of the page jobs cannot be determined.
pageexchange-package-invaliddata: A message on Special:Packages for an installed package whose stored package data cannot be decoded.
pageexchange-package-jobsunfinished:
An info message on Special:Packages for an installed package whose page jobs are not finished. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of queued jobs
* $2 - the number of jobs in progress or waiting for a retry
pageexchange-package-jobsfailed:
A warning message on Special:Packages for an installed package with failed page jobs. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of failed jobs
